findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "swap_quote" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rug_check, check_token, trending_tokens, search_venues, get_venue, swap_quote · Private data: rug_check, check_token, trending_tokens, search_venues, get_venue, compare_fees, recommend_venue, swap_quote, swap_submit · Public sink: swap_quote, swap_submit · Destructive: swap_submit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rug_check, check_token, trending_tokens, search_venues, get_venue, swap_quote · Private data: rug_check, check_token, trending_tokens, search_venues, get_venue, compare_fees, recommend_venue, swap_quote, swap_submit · Public sink: swap_quote, swap_submit · Destructive: swap_submit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
